causal_integration · 17 audit items · 67 tests passing · 23 Aug 2026

Every design-document guard, now verified

The audit found three things that would have quietly corrupted the headline result: a control config that was a copy of the flagship, a population code whose true uncertainty ran 26–54% above what the targets assumed, and a design formula that was not actually the ideal observer. All seventeen items are resolved, and the pipeline now refuses to train on a dataset that fails a design criterion.

§8

The gate now runs before training

scripts/00_calibrate.py is a new first stage. It exits non-zero on any FAIL, so run_all.sh stops before spending a training run on a miscalibrated dataset — confirmed by pointing it at the old default config, which halts at stage 0 and writes nothing.

§4

The failure that mattered most

Reliability enters the network only through spike-count gain, so if the Poisson code carries less information than the nominal σ², every target is miscalibrated — and because gain scales as K/σ², the error is multiplicative and uniform across the whole reliability range, including the ambiguous regime the whole study lives in. Maximum-likelihood decoding of the visual population, at both ends of the σ range:

defaultK = 10
54%FAIL
realisticK = 15
38%FAIL
matlab_matchK = 50
26%FAIL
flagshipK = 180
3%PASS

Variance inflation over nominal σ², paired estimate. Tolerance is a few percent. The push–pull hand and eye codes were already within 2% at every gain — the gaussian visual code was the only binding constraint.

§9

Three findings, three fixes

Was silently wrong

The p_common = 1 control was a copy of the flagship

Byte-identical to matlab_match.yaml, prior still 0.5. Any σout taken from it was meaningless. Now a real control: targets reduce to the fused solution to 1.1e−07, and σout = 0.627° feeds the σw filter.

Absent

Nothing checked that sources stayed in range

Up to 4.6% of trials put the visual measurement outside the reliably encoded span, where the input carries less than the target assumes. Rejection sampling now runs through the identical code path, so it cannot become a cue to C. Flagship rejects 0.9%.

Design doc, not code

The document’s eye transform is not the ideal observer

Brute-force integration over (C, source, eye) matches the code’s prior-shrinkage form to ~1e−13; the document’s plain-sum formula is off by up to 0.076 in p(C=1|x). The code is right — amend §5. That integration is now a test.

§7.1

The headline analysis exists now

Regressing (network − segregated) on wopt·Δ needs no division, so trials where the two hypotheses agree — where behaviour cannot reveal the weight — carry almost no leverage instead of exploding.

§7.3

The variance signature is there

The mixture variance carries a between-component term w(1−w)(fused−seg)² that humps at intermediate ambiguity. No fixed-weight model can produce it — which is what makes this the analysis that covers the zone where weight recovery is blind.

§7.4

Averaging beats selection, in the zone that discriminates

Five comparators binned by posterior decile. The per-bin statistic is a least-squares implied weight, not a mean signed bias — the latter cancels within a bin because Δ is signed, which is what made the first version of this panel read as flat.

50,000 trials, flagship plus both controls plus the always-fuse twin. Read this as evidence the machinery works, not as final science — one seed, one architecture.

One number to treat with care. Hand-vs-visual weight consistency comes out at r = 0.125. The σw filter keeps high-|Δ| trials, which are overwhelmingly confident-segregation trials, so wopt barely varies across the surviving set and the correlation has almost nothing to correlate. The mean absolute difference, 0.141, is the informative statistic there.

→

Reproducing this

make calibrate CONFIG=configs/flagship.yaml    # the gate
make all       CONFIG=configs/flagship.yaml    # 50k trials end to end
make test                                      # 67 property tests

python scripts/03_analyze.py --run flagship \
    --twin flagship_twin --control pcommon1     # sigma_out from the control

The two sub-optimalities — regression slope 0.86, reliability slope 0.57 — are consistent with each other and now attributable to the network rather than the pipeline, because every §10 guard is verified. Per the design document, that makes them reportable findings rather than failures.
